layer.label: See Through stars
layer.note: The 5,800 stars of See Through that land on the 5,800 UK substations: star j carries key floor((j + 0.5) * SPACE / 20000), placed here by keyPlace, the same law See Through uses. A star is a line of code, not a substation; tap one to fall to its substation in See Through.

law.formula: key_j = floor((j + 0.5) * space / nrule), j < nsub
law.remap: j = floor(key * nrule / space_old); valid when floor((j + 0.5) * space_old / nrule) == key; then key_new = floor((j + 0.5) * space_new / nrule)
